newsitem.title: USA: GE /Greenwich Air/UNC say more data requested.
newsitem.headline: GE /Greenwich Air/UNC say more data requested.

text.p: General Electric Co, Greenwich Air Services Inc, and UNC Inc said Monday that they have received requests for additional information from the Antitrust Division of the Department of Justice in connection with its review of GE's proposed acquisition of Greenwich and UNC, which was announced March 10.

Such information requests, said the companies, have the effect of extending the Hart-Scott- Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act waiting period until 20 days after the parties have substantially complied with the information requests.

The companies said that they intend to comply with the requests as promptly as possible, and expect the transaction will close within the next several months following the completion of the regulatory process and the required shareholder approvals.
